title: Outsiders buying land in Srinagar, NC must be held accountable for demographic changes: Altaf Bukhari
description: J&K Apni Party president urges Prime Minister Narendra Modi to initiate a direct dialogue with the people of J&K ‘to address their issues and grievances’, and says, ‘The prevailing trust deficit will not end until direct talks are held between the Centre and the people, particularly the youth of J&K’
